subject.title: fix: stop selected channel sessions from WebChat

question: Should a Control UI `/stop` for a selected non-global channel session implicitly discard that session’s queued followup and lane work when there is no browser-local run ID?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically bounded and preserves existing callers by making `clearQueued` opt-in, but the UI newly opts into destructive queue cleanup, so code review cannot determine whether that cancellation semantics is the intended product contract.

options.title: Adopt cancel-and-clear semantics
options.body: Keep `clearQueued: true` for selected non-global Control UI stops so the visible stop cannot immediately promote queued successor work.

options.title: Preserve queued work by default
options.body: Keep the selected-session abort but remove the implicit UI queue cleanup, reserving queue discard for a separately explicit user action.

recommendation.title: Adopt cancel-and-clear semantics
recommendation.body: Keep `clearQueued: true` for selected non-global Control UI stops so the visible stop cannot immediately promote queued successor work.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest demonstrated continuity across the predecessor and current selected-channel-session abort design; a repository maintainer should make the final product decision.
